profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, trading under the ticker COUR. Its site describes it as a provider of online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with offerings from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also sells Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company's catalog covers AI, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering. Named programs include the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera describes these as job-aligned programs built with employers and universities, and says learners commonly move into roles in project management, UX design, and data science, or start with beginner-friendly Python or generative AI courses.

Company records list no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. A California legal exposure count of 281 is recorded, along with the SEC central index key 0001651562.
